methods.name: DSFA (Domain Style and Feature Adaptation)
methods.summary: DSFA is an unsupervised domain adaptation method for landslide detection. It uses a domain style adaptation strategy to shift landslide styles at the dataset level, and integrates adversarial learning and domain distance minimization at the feature level to learn domain-invariant representations. It also uses an improved U-Net3+ architecture that replaces max-pooling with tokenized MLP modules to prevent information loss.
methods.source: Penglei Li, Yi Wang, Tongzhen Si, Kashif Ullah, Wei Han & Lizhe Wang
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a novel Domain Style and Feature Adaptation (DSFA) method for cross-scene landslide detection from high spatial resolution images... The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
